name: Kashi-ko Tsuki
source:
The story takes place in summer in the countryside, where there are only about three TV channels.
Yes, it is a place where you can look around and see fields, no 24-hour convenience stores, and raccoons roaming the streets at night.
By the time the American wind blows over Tokyo and reaches this place as a gentle breeze, the wind has already changed direction.
The protagonist is a female student who lives in such a place that is nothing out of the ordinary, except for its remoteness.
Even she is living with the same thoughts and hopes as anyone else.

She wants to go shopping in town, or eat a full meal of chocolate parfait.
It may or may not be such a modest hope.

In such a tranquil atmosphere, on the way home from shopping at a candy store as usual, the female student looked up and saw a girl looking at her curiously.
She had a tail and ears, and was said to be a fox in disguise.
During the summer vacation, the main girl met her often and was eventually guided to her house, Mayoiga that ordinary people could not find.
There lived a sister fox and a mother fox......

[From [url=https://shi.in/kashi.htm]Official Website[/url]]
